title: Paintbrush · archive operation

source.why_this_clip: A pointed artist's paintbrush is seen close up over tan paper, tip up and to the left and handle running off the bottom edge, and it shifts and dabs as it paints a thin line. The whole 3 s clip has no detected cuts and the brush is in view throughout, so the full clip is used.

source_selection.evidence: Sixteen raw-source samples visually inspected in preflight/source-design-sheet.jpg; final source-contact-sheet.jpg additionally spans refined clock interval. No cut/dissolve in selected event.

vector_observation_clock.method: Estimated local pixel appearance correspondence between frozen SAM JPEGs and retained raw frames; grayscale96x72RMSE<=2 andrunnerupgap>=.25. Ambiguous samples use clock interpolation between accepted anchors, or nominal12fps extrapolation at ends.

assembly_summary: The original five-stroke brush follows source-observed tip motion over a held paper ground. Progressive paint marks are separately credited operational context.
review_note: Fresh blind still review passed native identity and sampled source framing/pose. Final same-instance mask fit, classifier and normal-speed playback remain unrun; zero verified planted intervals fails the contact gate. No training ran. Raster trace fidelity remains below its unchanged threshold (minimum recall 0.8979); all measured ink components are retained.
